t: Section 1124(g) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by striking out “program report” in the last sentence and inserting in place thereof “progress report”.

fable.w: This is a purely technical amendment that replaces the phrase "program report" with "progress report" in 10 U.S.C. 1124(g). The tempting reading is that a "report" implies some consultative process, but the text creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking, consultation with outside parties, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is brought into any federal decision.
fable.s: is amended by striking out “program report” in the last sentence and inserting in place thereof “progress report”
